title: vereia rotundifolia
intro: Vereia rotundifolia, commonly known as Round-leaved Vereia or Round-leaved Vereia, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Vereia rotundifolia include its ability to act as a bronchodilator and to inhibit histamine release, making it a potential treatment for respiratory issues and allergies. The bioactive constituents of Vereia rotundifolia include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
